# wreckit — Bulletproof AI Code Verification

wreckit is a language-agnostic, framework-agnostic code verification platform. It orchestrates a swarm of parallel verification workers — slop scanner, type checker, mutation tester, SAST analyzer, and more — then corroborates results to produce a tamper-evident proof bundle with a Ship / Caution / Blocked verdict. No external CI infrastructure required.

## Product

- **Site**: https://wreckit-ralph.vercel.app
- **OpenClaw Skill**: `clawhub install wreckit` (v2.3.1)
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/christiancattaneo/wreckit
- **Status**: Live — skill available, SaaS tier coming soon

## Key Capabilities

- **AI Slop Scan** — detects placeholder code, template artifacts, and empty stubs
- **Type Checking** — tsc / mypy / cargo check / go vet based on auto-detected stack
- **Mutation Testing** — mutmut / cargo-mutants / Stryker with AI fallback
- **Test Quality Gate** — coverage, test structure, red-green discipline
- **Cross-Verification** — independent agent corroborates builder's claims
- **SAST / Red Team** — 20+ vulnerability patterns, ReDoS, secrets detection
- **Dynamic Analysis** — memory leaks, race conditions, FD leaks
- **Performance Benchmarks** — regression detection vs baseline
- **Proof Bundle** — `.wreckit/proof.json` with Ship / Caution / Blocked verdict
- **Four Modes** — BUILD, REBUILD, FIX, AUDIT

## Pricing

- **Free**: Open-source skill via ClawHub — self-hosted, unlimited use
- **Pro** (coming soon): $9/mo — hosted verification, audit log, PR integration
- **Team** (coming soon): $29/mo — team dashboards, shared proof bundles, SSO
